checklist.notes: The staff reply, the three listening questions, and the explicit check sentences make every requested response available and independently self-checkable from the supplied text and recording.
One station scenario, two socially differentiated request forms, three repeated travel facts, and a short record-replay check are manageable within 35 minutes at A2.1.

The repaired sequence now forms a complete chain: Mai reads the board, makes a context-suitable request, receives staff confirmation, mediates the same facts to Linh, then records and checks all three turns by listening.

Contrasting a respectful staff request with a collaborative friend request, requiring justification and adaptation, and carrying confirmed facts into mediation directly support socially suitable requesting, narration, and mediation.
The lesson moves from supported fact recall through modeled request choice and adaptation to mediated transfer, then integrates pronunciation, speaking, and listening self-check.

The previous missing-staff-reply defect is corrected: the staff utterance supplies the tested facts, and the final check states the expected answers, so a self-study learner can complete and verify the mediation/listening flow.
The concrete relationship-sensitive request contrast and explicit word-stress cue offer useful support without making unsupported population-wide claims about Vietnamese learners.
